title: Abell 2744 · F814W / convergence audit derivative

display.kappaUnit: dimensionless convergence from source product; area-mean aggregated

provenance.derivativeMethod: Each 128×128 output cell is the finite-pixel area mean of one non-overlapping bin on the 4000×4000 Sharon WCS. No lens-map interpolation is performed in this step.

limitations: The web derivative is for inspection and teaching, not publication-grade measurement.
Area aggregation removes angular-resolution information; use the full FITS products for inference.
Only the Sharon/Johnson v4cor reconstruction is bundled, so between-team systematics are absent.
F814W surface brightness is a morphology proxy, not a stellar-mass map.
